content_html:
Prompt Analysis Pipeline

From Text to Response in a Transformer LLM

A “prompt analysis” is the transformer’s process of contextualizing tokens and predicting responses; it’s probabilistic, context‑bound, and guided by both your input and overarching instructions.

The model processes your prompt as tokens within a context window, builds contextual representations via attention, and decodes an answer token by token, applying formatting/safety constraints.

Stage What Happens Why It Matters
Context assembly System + developer + user turns are concatenated. Steers style, safety, and task constraints.
Tokenization Subword segmentation (BPE/Unigram; byte fallback). Balances coverage and efficiency.
Embeddings IDs → vectors; add positional encodings. Lets the model represent similarity and order.
Self‑attention Tokens compute relevance weights to others. Builds long‑range dependencies and disambiguates meaning.
Decoding Transforms representations into probabilities over the vocabulary. Controls creativity vs. determinism.
Post‑processing Applies formatting, safety, and tool‑use rules. Aligns outputs with instructions and user needs.
